newsitem.title: UK: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil at stand off.
newsitem.headline: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil at stand off.

text.p: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil prices were again at a stand-off on Monday with buyers and sellers almost ten dollars a tonne apart, traders said.
On Friday an Irish player sold a cargo to a refiner at $143 cif NWE, and an ARA player was heard having sold to another refiner, also on Friday, at $137 fob NWE.
Potential buyers said the length in the market had kept prices low at around $135 fob NWE, while a potential seller said crude oil's rise had boosted prices closer to $144 fob.
An E-4 cargo was heard available from a trader at mmm +$3-$4. -- Nicholas Shaxson, London newsroom +44 171 542 8167
